morbi.headline: Morbi cluster faces mixed pressures from volatile fuel costs and declining exports alongside select earnings beats.
what_changed: Natural gas prices received a Rs 5 discount following state representations.
Propane gas prices surged by Rs 7,300 per metric tonne.
Exports experienced a reported 50% decline alongside gas price hikes.
stress_signals: Propane-fired vitrified and wall tile manufacturing kilns face immediate margin pressure [2f37d34283cf].
Gas price hikes and a 50% export drop deliver a major blow to the sector [c2e1d2a72338].
Large suspicious stock of imported coal discovered in a closed ceramic factory in Rafaleshwar GIDC [f675c060fa53].
improvement_signals: Morbi ceramic industry received a Rs 5 discount on natural gas prices [279312659941].
Kajaria Ceramics reported a beat on both sales and profit estimates for Q2 2026 [c28b87e03125].
Varmora Granito financial results indicate recovery in the ceramic tile industry [3ede25f378d4].
what_to_watch: Monitor working capital utilization and debt servicing for propane-dependent MSME kilns.
Track sustainability of natural gas price relief and actual supplier pricing structures.
Assess export order book recovery and inventory holding levels across regional units.

surat.headline: Surat cluster faces pre-Diwali liquidity stress, wage defaults, and power disruptions despite technical textile diversification.
what_changed: Pre-Diwali power cuts across Gujarat threaten industrial output, causing estimated textile sector weekly losses of Rs 300 crore [37c492915105].
Surat is expanding manufacturing scope into defence fabrics and exploring technical textile collaborations with Mercedes-Benz and MANTRA [3a4ce1852d7c, c4aec155608f].
Diamond and textile units report pre-Diwali labor shortages, demand challenges, and artisan wage payment protests [c8a89bd2019b, 402ab705574d, 0bc3ac5bf041].
stress_signals: A textile mill operator was defrauded of Rs 1.69 crore via a broker [25d6a0f6dbec].
Diamond artisans face pending salaries exceeding Rs 20 lakh for 20 workers, alongside a broader unspecified diamond unit default (uthamnu) ahead of Diwali [402ab705574d, 8f729a2b282e].
Diamond Worker Union submitted a memorandum demanding unpaid bonuses and overtime dues [c8a89bd2019b].
Surat Diamond Bourse continues to struggle with operational traction and trader relocation three years post-launch [b55c8a265aa2].
improvement_signals: Mercedes-Benz is exploring technical textile collaboration with MANTRA [3a4ce1852d7c].
Surat is expanding manufacturing into defence fabrics, boosting the technical textile sector [c4aec155608f].
Gem exporters are actively rebuilding US business and exploring new markets [37e6ab2a18cd].
what_to_watch: Post-Diwali labor return rates and resolution of artisan wage dues in diamond and textile units.
Actual commercial implementation and investment scales for defence and technical textile initiatives.
Account-level liquidity and repayment track records in accounts exposed to broker-led fabric distribution.
